name: Nonprofit Sponsorship
tagline: Teal, coral, and yellow nonprofit sponsorship deck with large circular shapes, rounded bars, and community photo zones.

palette.description: Deep teal base, coral divider slides, yellow callout pills, pale teal accents, and soft community-photo placeholders.

typography.style: Rounded geometric sans, large friendly headings, and plain sponsorship copy.

best_for: Nonprofit event sponsorship decks, community partnership proposals, fundraising packages, and sponsor benefit explainers.
avoid_for: Formal grants, legal briefings, or sober board materials where the rounded color system would feel too casual.

source_inspiration.name: Visme Nonprofit Event Sponsorship Presentation
source_inspiration.notes: Source-inspired HTML/CSS template rebuilt from public visual reference only; not a pixel copy and does not reuse source assets.
